name: EMON Schema
description: Official EMON (Efficient Minimal Object Notation) schema definition. Supports inline and nested types, triple-quoted multiline text, and comments.

definitions.description: Defines data structure (schema) with optional array indicator [].
Defines data rows matching a schema (start with =). Each value follows field order.
Defines field data type. Can be basic, array, nested, or reference type.
Triple-quoted text block preserving line breaks and spaces. Converts to JSON string with \n.
Reference to another schema or nested type definition.
Comments start with // and are ignored by parser.
